 Μake us preferred on Google Greece’s under-17 national team is about to make history as it competes in the final stage of the FIFA U-17 World Cup for the first time. The tournament kicks off in Qatar on Thursday, November 19, and Vasilis Papadakis’s squad opens its Group A campaign against Egypt. The young Greeks will then face Panama and the hosts, Qatar, as they push for a place in the round of 32. ERT2 Sport will broadcast all of Greece’s matches. The team is already in Doha and has completed most of its preparation. Papadakis has a fully fit squad to choose from for the opener. The coach spoke of his pride in reaching the tournament, calling it a well-deserved reward for both the players and Greek soccer. “We are happy and proud to be here,” he said. “It is a great experience and a big reward for the boys and for Greek soccer. We can’t wait for the first game, and together, believing in our abilities, we will give our best for the national team, as always.” NEWSLETTER TABLE TALK
